hints: Look at when the default value comes into existence. Is it built once or on every call?
The likely mistake is assuming team=[] means "a new empty list each time". You need a default that can't be changed, and a fresh list built inside the function.
solution_explanation: None is immutable and means "not passed". Checking for it inside the function means a new list is created on every call that needs one, while a team passed by the caller is still used as-is.
